ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 15, 2019 and to the campus on Monday, April 22, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
